title: The Classic of Netting — Luo Zhi Jing (English)
summary: A complete English translation of the Luo Zhi Jing in twelve scrolls: a manual of denunciation ascribed to the Tang inquisitor Lai Junchen. The histories record the title; the book itself was lost, and the text translated here was written under his name in modern times. The case is set out on the page.
